actual_game_ui: Unsupported future sanctum props, no native 3D or runtime placement review.

cells.subject: aster-cloud-vessel
cells.notes: Offset stepped lid, broad slots and stone cradle make a compact solid offering vessel. Warm broad planes stay readable without repeating the bolt mark.

cells.subject: neris-current-coffer
cells.notes: Supported hinged lid, hollow rim and aqua insert read at native/compact sizes. Exterior planes lean toward stone rather than glazed ceramic; material remains a proposal.

cells.subject: vesta-ember-press
cells.notes: Screw, connected frame, slotted copper cheek and recessed coal read clearly. Strong supported construction distinguishes it from an existing brazier or furnace monument.

cells.subject: isen-salt-casket
cells.notes: Sliding thick lid, open dark cavity and icy rim establish a distinct long casket. Broad pale surfaces stay legible; fine frost is intentionally subordinate.

cells.subject: nyra-folded-screen
cells.notes: Unequal panels, feet and actual hinge positions are clear at compact size. The returned panels are gray and rigid rather than the requested plum cloth; useful screen construction study, not a finished patron-material match.

aesthetic_acceptance: Optional candidates with explicit material departures. No reroll; user acceptance pending.
